method.baselineGear: Only main hand plus specified shield; all other slots empty; no injuries, upgrades or consumables.
method.reference: Same-level getCharacterStatistics armor and raw meleeDamage; no enemy block. EHP = maxHp * incoming raw hit / actual mitigated incoming hit. DPT = actual mitigated outgoing hit * floor(AP / attack AP). Score = DPT * EHP.
method.continuousSensitivity: Explicit approximation only: EHP = HP * (1 + armor/100) / (1 - block/100); outgoing hit = raw / (1 + target armor/100) * (1 - target block/100), with no integer rounding. Store continuous DPT and score alongside authoritative rounded hits. Sword is also summarized separately; other 1H utility such as initiative is not valued by this metric.
method.spread: 100 * (stronger score / weaker score - 1); approximately 15% is a heuristic, not a failing assertion. Outside-target counts use 1e-9 percentage-point tolerance to avoid treating floating-point 15.000000000000014 as an overrun; exact observed values remain stored.
method.encounters: Actual BattleService.startBattle outputs, solo. Fixed enemies retain their fixed stats; scaling enemies use service level floors and 10/25 group changes. Duplicate forest-boars-02 omitted because it shares the forest-boars-01 profile.
method.turns: Stationary, legal in-range/LOS attacks, fresh full AP every turn; attack actions count overkill per enemy. Incoming group DPT holds all enemies alive, so it is a pressure bound, not a duel result.
method.healing: Live getBattleHealingPreview confirms 3 AP and second heal unavailable. One heal/turn plus attacks from remaining AP; full power requires enough missing HP. Negative net loss is capacity, not invulnerability.
method.limitations: No movement, blocked LOS, ranged approach advantage, initiative/turn-order kills, injury proc, focus-fire, ally healing or PvP win-rate simulation. Score comparisons do not establish perfect PvP balance. Enemy generation has random IDs; only deterministic stat outputs are retained.
